name: global-market-cloudflare
description: GLOBAL MARKET - correction anti-503 : ressources statiques servies sans Function, API isolée et continuité sécurisée du Super Admin.

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run test:isolation && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev public
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name=global-market
